purpose.domain_detail: Implements a singly linked list data structure as a learning exercise, referencing 'Essential Algorithms' by Rod Stephens
purpose.summary: This program builds a singly linked list by accepting user input for a specified number of elements, storing them in an array-based structure with pointers. It then searches for a target value in the list and calls an external 'findcell' subprogram to locate a cell before the target.

notable_features: ALLOCATE verb with LOC clause (non-standard extension)
usage is pointer / value is null
program-id AS clause with dotnet-style namespace string
OCCURS with INDEXED BY on pointer items
verdict.notes: Missing IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header (only program-id present); indentation is inconsistent suggesting a beginner. The AS clause in program-id and ALLOCATE LOC syntax point to Micro Focus or a .NET COBOL environment. Typos in comments ('Emter', 'BuildLinkedLisrLinkedList') suggest student work. The OCCURS clause with INDEXED BY used on pointer items and the array-based linked list simulation are unusual constructs.
